description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


📖 Read the announcement blog post: https://tabularis.dev/blog/v0330-open-data-files-ai-completion-read-only-connections?utm_src=github-release
See the assets below to download this version and install.
🐳 Self-host in the browser: docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -v tabularis-data:/data ghcr.io/tabularisdb/tabularis:0.33.0 (see the container guide).
